outputs.description: One guide per entry of scaffoldKinds, in that order, with topic set to the kind and summary, contains and example command taken from that kind's scaffoldDetails entry. It matters when a caller needs the guidance for every scaffold kind at once; the extra rules that the guides list in guide.ts adds to topics that have a naming rule are not included.

examples.summary: Email rendering without delivery side effects.
steps: Generate the scaffold.
Keep the generated file focused on one responsibility.
Replace placeholder behavior with the smallest useful implementation.
Run the generated test and the project check.
rules: Generated code is a starting shape.
Organize every module kind by responsibility: src/<kind>/<category>/<module>. Keep owner-private code inside its owner category and keep stable unit IDs.
Keep public behavior covered by focused tests.
This scaffold is package-safe.
antiPatterns: Do not hide unrelated workflow inside the generated file.

outputs.name: scaffoldsGuide
outputs.description: The overview of the scaffold catalog: fixed topic, summary, steps, anti-patterns and example commands, plus one rule per entry of scaffoldKinds in that order, written as 'kind: summary' with an App-only or Game-only suffix when the kind has that scope. It matters when a caller needs the index of every scaffold kind; it does not include the contains lists that scaffoldGuides provides for each kind.

Use --json when an agent needs structured scaffold metadata.
Choose app-only scaffolds only inside Harness app projects.
rules: service: Workflow logic with one reason to change.
component: Reusable Svelte UI component. App-only.
mailer: Email rendering without delivery side effects.
antiPatterns: Do not guess a scaffold shape when harness info can describe it.

outputs.name: namingGuide
outputs.description: The naming guide with fixed topic, summary, steps, anti-patterns and example commands, and rules that list every harnessNamingRules value, then every harnessModuleGroupRules entry, then three fixed naming notes. It matters when a caller needs the canonical source names for module types; it does not list scaffold kinds or contains lists.

examples.summary: Canonical source names for every module type, shared by generators, audit and code catalogs.
steps: Read the scaffold rule before generating code.
Review the actual operation and one concrete call.
Run harness audit and the project check.
rules: Naming: Components use <PascalName>.svelte and the same PascalCase import name.
Naming: Unit tests use <kebab-name>.test.ts.
Pure shared helper callables use camelCase; the helper scaffold generates a PascalNameHelper class and follows the class rule.
Keep class, component, model, function and module identities identical in cards, usage links and detail headings.
Preserve registered unit IDs and history when renaming source; descriptive responsibilities are separate from code names.
antiPatterns: Do not invent a code name by recasing a descriptive title.
Do not add a card-only name override.
